hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and re-election crisis

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Milei's polarizing leadership, economic shock therapy, and the high stakes of his re-election bid in 2027.

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the AfD's rapid electoral gains, comparisons to historical fascism, and the existential threat it poses to Germany's democratic institutions.
